title: Flight Compartment Wiring — Overhead Panel and Upper Avionics Feeds
abstract: Wiring diagram for the overhead panel harnesses and the feeds that run aft from them into the upper avionics compartment, including the equipment control lines that pass through the crown route.

sections.purpose: Wiring diagram of the overhead panel harnesses and the feeds running aft into the upper avionics compartment through the crown route.
sections.sheet_note: The sheet is drawn looking up at the overhead panel with the liner removed. The crown route shown along the top of the sheet is shared: several systems run their control and status lines through it and the available capacity is a recurring constraint when new equipment is added. The equipment list gives the items whose control lines terminate on this diagram; the equipment itself is described in its own chapter and does not appear here.
sections.routing_note: The crown route runs aft from the overhead panel along the cabin ceiling centre line and drops into the upper avionics compartment at the station given on the sheet. Support intervals are given for the whole run. No branch may be added to this route without a capacity check, because the clamp blocks are sized to the current bundle diameter and there is no margin at the drop.
